```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(sf)
```

# RESISTANCE
# Test 1

```{r}
# Harvested Biomass by Species, Management Area & prescription Type
harvestSummary <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 1/biomass-harvest-summary-log.csv")
managementLabels <- c("1" = "Private Non-Corporate", "2" = "Private Corporate", "3" = "Public")
prescriptionLabels <- c("LOB_PLANTATION" = "Loblolly", "OH_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Hickory", "OP_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Pine", "SOFT_RESISTANCE" = "Softwoods")
harvestSummary[,c(1,2,3,38:67)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("BiomassHarvestedMg_ACRU":"BiomassHarvestedMg_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Harvested_Biomass") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", ""),
         Prescription = str_replace(Prescription, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Harvested_Biomass, col = Species, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(Prescription ~ ManagementArea,
             labeller = labeller(ManagementArea = managementLabels, Prescription = prescriptionLabels)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Biomass in Millions of Mg",
                     breaks = c(0,1e6,2e6,3e6),
                     labels = c(0,1,2,3))


# Composition through time
resistanceBiomass <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 1/spp-biomass-log.csv")
resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_MG, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Landscape Biomass (kg/m2)",
                     breaks = c(0,5e3,1e4,1.5e4,2e4),
                     labels = c(0,5,10,15,20))

resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), 
               names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalBiomass = sum(Biomass_MG),
         Biomass_Percent = (Biomass_MG / TotalBiomass) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_Percent, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Biomass (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))


# Reproduction: Cohorts seeded and cohorts resprouted
reproductionDf <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 1/NECN-reproduction-log.csv")
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  mutate(TotalCohortsSeeded = NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = TotalCohortsSeeded, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic()
# Proportion
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalSeeds = sum(NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout),
         Cohorts_percent = ((NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) / TotalSeeds) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Cohorts_percent, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Cohorts Seeded (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))
```

```{r}
managementLabels <- c("1" = "Private Non-Corporate", "2" = "Private Corporate", "3" = "Public")
prescriptionLabels <- c("LOB_PLANTATION" = "Loblolly", "OH_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Hickory", "OP_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Pine", "SOFT_RESISTANCE" = "Softwoods")
harvestSummary[,c(1,2,3,38:67)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("BiomassHarvestedMg_ACRU":"BiomassHarvestedMg_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Harvested_Biomass") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", ""),
         Prescription = str_replace(Prescription, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Harvested_Biomass, col = Species, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(Prescription ~ ManagementArea,
             labeller = labeller(ManagementArea = managementLabels, Prescription = prescriptionLabels)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Biomass in Millions of Mg",
```
```{r}
                     breaks = c(0,1e6,2e6,3e6,4e6),
                     labels = c(0,1,2,3,4))


# Composition through time
resistanceBiomass <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 12/spp-biomass-log.csv")
resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_MG, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Landscape Biomass (kg/m2)",
                     breaks = c(0,5e3,1e4,1.5e4,2e4),
                     labels = c(0,5,10,15,20))

resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), 
               names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalBiomass = sum(Biomass_MG),
         Biomass_Percent = (Biomass_MG / TotalBiomass) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_Percent, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Biomass (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))


# Reproduction: Cohorts seeded and cohorts resprouted
reproductionDf <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 12/NECN-reproduction-log.csv")
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  mutate(TotalCohortsSeeded = NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = TotalCohortsSeeded, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic()
# Proportion
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalSeeds = sum(NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout),
         Cohorts_percent = ((NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) / TotalSeeds) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Cohorts_percent, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Cohorts Seeded (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))
```

```{r}
prescriptionLabels <- c("LOB_PLANTATION" = "Loblolly", "OH_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Hickory", "OP_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Pine", "SOFT_RESISTANCE" = "Softwoods")
harvestSummary[,c(1,2,3,38:67)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("BiomassHarvestedMg_ACRU":"BiomassHarvestedMg_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Harvested_Biomass") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", ""),
         Prescription = str_replace(Prescription, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Harvested_Biomass, col = Species, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
```

```{r}
prescriptionLabels <- c("LOB_PLANTATION" = "Loblolly", "OH_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Hickory", "OP_RESISTANCE" = "Oak-Pine", "SOFT_RESISTANCE" = "Softwoods")
harvestSummary[,c(1,2,3,38:67)] %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("BiomassHarvestedMg_ACRU":"BiomassHarvestedMg_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Harvested_Biomass") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", ""),
         Prescription = str_replace(Prescription, "\\s*\\([^)]*\\)", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Harvested_Biomass, col = Species, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_classic() +
  facet_grid(Prescription ~ ManagementArea,
             labeller = labeller(ManagementArea = managementLabels, Prescription = prescriptionLabels)) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Biomass in Millions of Mg",
                     breaks = c(0,1e6,2e6,3e6,4e6),
                     labels = c(0,1,2,3,4))


# Composition through time
resistanceBiomass <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 34/spp-biomass-log.csv")
resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_MG, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Landscape Biomass (kg/m2)",
                     breaks = c(0,5e3,1e4,1.5e4,2e4),
```
```{r}
                     labels = c(0,5,10,15,20)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.35e4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.8e4)

resistanceBiomass %>%
  filter(NumActiveSites != 0) %>%
  select(-EcoName, -NumActiveSites, -`...34`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("AboveGroundBiomass_ACRU":"AboveGroundBiomass_TADI2"), 
               names_to = "Species", values_to = "Biomass_MG") %>%
  mutate(Species = str_replace(Species, "^[^_]*_", "")) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalBiomass = sum(Biomass_MG),
         Biomass_Percent = (Biomass_MG / TotalBiomass) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Biomass_Percent, fill = Species)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Biomass (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))


# Reproduction: Cohorts seeded and cohorts resprouted
reproductionDf <- read_csv("C:/Users/lagoodal/Desktop/Dissertation Stuff/Chapter 2/LANDIS Outputs/TREE MAP/NEW/RESISTANCE/Test 34/NECN-reproduction-log.csv")
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  mutate(TotalCohortsSeeded = NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = TotalCohortsSeeded, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic()
# Proportion
reproductionDf %>%
  select(-`...7`) %>%
  group_by(Time) %>%
  mutate(TotalSeeds = sum(NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout),
         Cohorts_percent = ((NumCohortsSeed + NumCohortsResprout) / TotalSeeds) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = Time, y = Cohorts_percent, fill = SpeciesName)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", col = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Proportional Cohorts Seeded (%)",
                     limits = c(0, 100),
                     breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
                     labels = seq(0, 100, by = 20))
```
